summary.text: Lisa Fragala is a Democratic state representative from Oregon House District 8 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A longtime educator, she has served on the Lane Community College board and the City of Eugene Planning Commission.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Fragala earned a bachelor's degree from Binghamton University in 1990 and a graduate degree from Oregon State University in 2001, and she attended Lane Community College.
Her career experience includes working for the U.S. Forest Service on endangered species and as an educator in public K-12 schools and at Pacific University's College of Education.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Fragala said she had lived in House District 8 for more than 30 years, had worked as an educator for close to 25, and had served on the Lane Community College Board of Education and the City of Eugene Planning Commission since 2018.
She said housing affordability and homelessness were among the most critical issues she would work on in Salem.
Fragala assumed office on January 13, 2025, succeeding Paul Holvey, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
